training.refit: Fresh model on full permitted monthly training cohort, including already observed past2024; fixed selected inner epoch count; no warm start
training.batch_order: Deterministic generator seeded with stage seed+17; shuffled windows, chronology of sample construction remains intact

primary_metric: Annual pooled RMSE per independent training-seed trajectory, original sigma7 units
scope: Prospective RNG confirmation conditional on known development2024; not independent temporal validation
HPO: None; three original recipes fixed before new runs
seed_rule: base+100000*monthordinal; refit adds10000000; minibatch adds17; paired across families
seed_role_safety: Odd base seeds in steps2; +17 batch states even; all month/stage/role states distinct and fresh across studies
prior_exposure: 2024 and original test already known; old6201..6205 contextual and pooled25 sensitivity only

dimensioning.correction: Bonferroni planning; two-sided paired t with Holm3 final reporting
dimensioning.power_scope: Marginal design power under normal independent seed differences
dimensioning.hypothesis: Detect an absolute delta difference against zero, not superiority above a delta boundary
dimensioning.upper_sd_scope: One-sided marginal chi-square bound, not simultaneous95%
dimensioning.algorithm: Common maximum exact two-sided noncentral-t R using each n20 upperSD95; no silent cap
dimensioning.pooled25_sensitivity: Prior5 plus new20 reported separately; never determines definitive R
dimensioning.independence: Independent training randomizations conditional on one known market trajectory

analysis.primary_test: Two-sided paired Student t on annual per-seed RMSE; Holm correction for exactly three neural pairs
analysis.confidence_intervals: 95% marginal and simultaneous Bonferroni 1-alpha/3 family intervals
analysis.effect_size: Paired Cohen d_z with 4999 paired-seed bootstrap replicates as sensitivity
analysis.normality: Shapiro-Wilk and QQ diagnostics only; never switches the primary test
analysis.interpretation: Rejecting zero is distinct from exceeding practical delta; compare family intervals with +/-delta

phases.definitive: R new seeds per model, excluding all variance/pilot trajectories

publication: Versioned protocol/code/literature decision pushed before extension; separate R lock pushed before definitive
publication_scope: Aggregate metadata public; predictions, weights, scalers and fold copies private
